profiles.name: Hit and Run
chars: This model can Fall Back and still shoot and charge in the same turn.

profiles.name: Reign of Confusion
chars: If you have any models with this ability in your army, then during the first battle round you must roll a dice each time your opponent spends Command Points (CPs) to use a Stratagem. On a 4+, your opponent must spend one extra CP to use that Stratagem, or else it has no effect (the CPs spend so far are lost). This ability cannot affect Stratagems used 'before the battle begins'.

profiles.name: Polymorphine
chars: During deployment, you can set up this model in disguise instead of placing it on the battlefield.  At the end of any of your Movement phases this model can revert to its true form - set it up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than D6+3" away from any enemy models.  For example if you roll a 4, the model can be set up anywhere that is more than 7" from any enemy model.

rules.name: Lightning Reflexes
rules.text: A model with this special rule has a 4+ invulnerable save.

rules.name: Independent Operative
rules.text: This Model can never have a Warlord Trait. During deployment, you can set this model up in concealment instead of placing it on the battlefield. At the end of any of your movement phases, this model can reveal it's position - set it up anywhere on the battlefield that is more then 9" from any enemy model.

rules.name: Execution Force
rules.text: So long as your Warlord is from the IMPERIUM, you can include this unit in a Vanguard Detachment even if that Detachment contains no HQ units. However, if you do so, that Detachment's Command Benefits are changed to 'None' unless that Detachment contains exactly 1 of each assassin.

profiles.name: Neural Shredder
chars: Roll 3D6 if a unit is hit by this weapon; if the roll is equal to or greater then the target unit's highest Leadership characteristic, then it suffers D3 mortal wounds.

profiles.name: Phase Sword
chars: Invulnerable saves cannot be taken against attacks made with this weapon

profiles.name: Poison Blades
chars: Each time the bearer fights, it can make 1 additional attack with this weapon. This weapon wounds on a 3+, unless it is targeting a VEHICLE. in which case it wounds on a 6+

profiles.name: 11: Inspirational Fighter
chars: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 in the Fight phase for friendly <Sub-faction> units within 6" of this model.

profiles.name: 12: Beast Hunter
chars: You can re-roll failed wound rolls for attacks made by this model in the Fight phase if the target is a MONSTER unit.

profiles.name: 13: Heroic
chars: This model can perform a Heroic Intervention if, after the enemy has completed all of their charge moves, it is within 6" of any enemy units, and can move up to 6" when doing so.

profiles.name: 14: Duelist
chars: Add 1 to this model’s Strength and Attacks characteristics while it is within 1" of any enemy Character units.

profiles.name: 15: Zealot
chars: You can re-roll failed hit rolls for this model in the Fight phase if it made a charge move, performed a Heroic Intervention, or was charged this turn.

profiles.name: 16: Deadly Charge
chars: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this model in the Fight phase if it made a charge move this turn.

profiles.name: 21: Targeting Augury
chars: Enemy units do not gain the benefit of cover to their saving throws against attacks made by friendly <Sub-faction> units within 6" of this model when the attack is made.

profiles.name: 22: Directed Fire
chars: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 in the Shooting phase for friendly <Sub-faction> units within 6" of this model.

profiles.name: 23: Deadly Marksman
chars: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of ranged weapons used by this model.

profiles.name: 24: Sundering Shots
chars: Each wound roll of 6+ made for this model’s ranged attacks inflicts 1 mortal wound on the target in addition to any normal damage.

profiles.name: 25: Keen Eye
chars: This model can target enemy CHARACTER units in the Shooting phase even if they are not the closest enemy model.

profiles.name: 26: Defensive Fighter
chars: When this model fires Overwatch, it successfully hits on rolls of 5 or 6, instead of only 6.

profiles.name: 31: Grudge
chars: You can re-roll any hit, wound and damage rolls made for this model’s attacks that target the enemy Warlord.

profiles.name: 32: Resilient
chars: Each time this model loses a wound, roll a dice; on a 5+ it does not lose that wound.

profiles.name: 33: Camoflage
chars: Add 2 instead of 1 to saving throws made for this model when it is receiving the benefit of cover.

profiles.name: 34: Stealth Assault
chars: Enemy units cannot fire Overwatch at this model.

profiles.name: 35: Indomitable
chars: All damage suffered by this model is halved (rounding up).

profiles.name: 36: Impervious
chars: This model regains 1 lost wound at the start of your turn.

profiles.name: 41: Infiltrator
chars: During deployment, you can set up this model in ambush, instead of placing it on the battlefield. At the end of any of your Movement phases it can reveal its location – set it up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 9" from any enemy models.

profiles.name: 42: Stealthy
chars: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made with ranged weapons that target this model.

profiles.name: 43: Hard to Kill
chars: Wound rolls of 1, 2 or 3 made for attacks that target this model always fail, even if the attack has a Strength characteristic higher than this model’s Toughness characteristic.

profiles.name: 44: Strategic Feint
chars: At the start of the first battle round but before the first turn begins, you can pick a friendly <Sub-faction> unit within 6" of this model and set it up again, anywhere wholly within your deployment zone. If your opponent has any units with similar abilities, roll off; starting with the winner of the roll-off, take it in turns to resolve these abilities.

profiles.name: 45: Swift Strike
chars: You can always choose this model to fight first in the Fight phase even if it did not charge. If the enemy has units that have charged, or that have a similar ability, alternate choosing units to fight with, starting with the player whose turn is taking place.

profiles.name: 46: Foresight
chars: Once per battle, if this model is on the battlefield, you can re-roll one hit roll, wound roll, damage roll or saving throw.

profiles.name: 51: Inspirational Leader
chars: Friendly <Sub-faction>units can use this model’s Leadership instead of their own while they are within 6" of it.

profiles.name: 52: Rallying Cry
chars: You can re-roll failed Morale tests for friendly <Sub-faction>units while they are within 6" of this model.

profiles.name: 53: Icon of Retribution
chars: Roll a dice each time a friendly <Sub-faction>model within 6" of this model is slain in the Fight phase. On a 6, the unit that made the attack that slew the model suffers 1 mortal wound after it has finished making its attacks.

profiles.name: 54: Impetuous
chars: You can re-roll failed charge rolls for this model.

profiles.name: 55: Terrifying
chars: Subtract 1 from the Leadership characteristic of enemy units while they are within 3" of this model.

profiles.name: 56: Savage Riposte
chars: Each time you roll an unmodified saving throw of 6 for this model in the Fight phase, the enemy unit that made the attack suffers 1 mortal wound after it has resolved all of its attacks.

profiles.name: 61: Air Strike
chars: Once per battle, in your Shooting phase, you can pick an enemy unit, other than a Characterunit, that is visible to this model and roll a D6. On a 1-4 nothing happens. On a 5+ the target unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

profiles.name: 62: Swift Advance
chars: When this model Advances, add 6" to its Move characteristic for that Movement phase instead of rolling a D6

profiles.name: 63: Reactive Tactics
chars: This model, and friendly<Sub-faction>units within 6" of them, can charge even if they Fell Back that turn.

profiles.name: 64: Strike and Fade
chars: After this model has fought in the Fight phase, it can immediately pile in D3+3" in any direction, not just towards the closest enemy model.

profiles.name: 65: Final Strike
chars: If this model is slain, you can select an enemy unit within 3" of it and roll a D6; on a 2+ that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

profiles.name: 66: Direct Fire
chars: Each time you make a wound roll of 6+ in the Shooting phase for a friendly <Sub-faction>unit within 6" of this model, the AP characteristic of that attack is improved by 1 (e.g. AP -1 becomes AP -2).

profiles.name: 02: Auto-loader
chars: Pick one of this model’s ranged weapons. Increase the number of shots this weapon makes by 1 (e.g. a Pistol 1 weapon becomes a Pistol 2 weapon).

profiles.name: 03: Penetrator Rounds
chars: Pick one of this model’s ranged weapons. Improve that weapon’s AP characteristic by 1 (e.g. AP -1 becomes AP -2).

profiles.name: 04: High Calibre
chars: Pick one of this model’s ranged weapons. Add 1 to that weapon’s Strength characteristic.

profiles.name: 05: Improved Sights
chars: Pick one of this model’s ranged weapons. Add 6" to that weapon’s Range characteristic.

profiles.name: 06: Inferno Round
chars: Pick one of this model’s ranged weapons. Add the following ability to that weapon: ‘Units do not receive the benefit of cover to their saving throws against attacks made with this weapon.’

profiles.name: 07: Artificer Weapon
chars: Pick one of this model’s weapons. Add 1 to that weapon’s Damage characteristic.

profiles.name: 08: Finely Balanced
chars: Pick one of this model’s melee weapons. Add the following ability to that weapon: ‘Each time the bearer fights, it can make 1 additional attack with this weapon.’

profiles.name: 09: Shredder
chars: Pick one of this model’s melee weapons. Add the following ability to that weapon: ‘You can re-roll failed wound rolls for attacks made with this weapon.’

profiles.name: 10: Brutal
chars: Pick one of this model’s melee weapons. Improve that weapon’s Strength characteristic by 1 (e.g. User becomes +1, +1 becomes +2).

profiles.name: 11: Razor-edged
chars: Pick one of this model’s melee weapons. Improve that weapon’s AP characteristic by 1 (e.g. AP -1 becomes AP -2).

profiles.name: 12: Heirloom
chars: Pick one of this model’s melee weapons. Add the following ability to that weapon: ‘Each unmodified hit roll of 6 made for attacks with this weapon scores 2 hits instead of 1’.

profiles.name: 1: Psychic Might
chars: Add 1 to the number of psychic powers this character can attempt to manifest in your Psychic phase.

profiles.name: 2: Adamantium Will
chars: Add 1 to the number of psychic powers this character can attempt to deny in your opponent’s Psychic phase.

profiles.name: 3: Master of Lore
chars: Add 1 to the number of psychic powers this model knows from one of the psychic disciplines available to them.

profiles.name: 02: Old War Wound
chars: Select a result from this table, or roll 2D6 to randomly select a result (re-roll if you get this result again). Subtract or worsen this model’s characteristic by the amount described in the result you picked instead of adding or improving it (e.g. if the Ferocious Combatant result was selected, an Attacks characteristic of 3 would become 2, while if the Dead-eyed result was selected, a BS of 3+ would become 4+)

profiles.name: 03: Courageous
chars: Add 1 to this model’s Leadership characteristic.

profiles.name: 04: Ferocious Combatant
chars: Add 1 to this model’s Attacks characteristic.

profiles.name: 05: Mighty
chars: Add 1 to this model’s Strength characteristic.

profiles.name: 06: Dead-eyed
chars: Improve this model’s Ballistic Skill characteristic by 1 (e.g. BS 3+ will become BS 2+), to a maximum of 2+.

profiles.name: 07: Fleet
chars: Add 2" to this model’s Move characteristic.

profiles.name: 08: Blademaster
chars: Improve this model’s Weapon Skill characteristic by 1 (e.g. WS 3+ will become WS 2+), to a maximum of 2+.

profiles.name: 09: Enhanced Physiology
chars: Add 1 to this model’s Toughness characteristic.

profiles.name: 10: Toughened Armor
chars: Improve this model’s Save characteristic by 1 (e.g. Sv 5+ will become Sv 4+), to a maximum of 2+.

profiles.name: 11: Divine Protection
chars: Improve this model’s invulnerable save by 1 (e.g. an invulnerable save of 5+ will become an invulnerable save of 4+), to a maximum of 3+. If this model does not have an invulnerable save, it instead gains a 6+ invulnerable save.

profiles.name: 12: Heroic Constitution
chars: Add 1 to this model’s Wounds characteristic.

profiles.name: Etherium
chars: Each time an enemy model attacks this model, the attacks are resolved as if the the attacker had a BS/WS of 6+

profiles.name: Life Drain
chars: Armour saves cannot be taken against close combat attacks made by this model

profiles.name: Abomination
chars: This model can never be targeted or affected by psychic powers in any way. PSYKERS that are within 18" of any Culexus Assassins must subtract 2 from Psychic tests and Deny the witch tests they take.

chars: During deployment, you can set up this model in ambush, instead of placing it on the battlefield. At the end of any of your Movement phases it can reveal its location – set it up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 9" from any enemy models.

profiles.name: 42: Stealthy
chars: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made with ranged weapons that target this model.

profiles.name: 43: Hard to Kill
chars: Wound rolls of 1, 2 or 3 made for attacks that target this model always fail, even if the attack has a Strength characteristic higher than this model’s Toughness characteristic.

profiles.name: 44: Strategic Feint
chars: At the start of the first battle round but before the first turn begins, you can pick a friendly <Sub-faction> unit within 6" of this model and set it up again, anywhere wholly within your deployment zone. If your opponent has any units with similar abilities, roll off; starting with the winner of the roll-off, take it in turns to resolve these abilities.

profiles.name: 45: Swift Strike
chars: You can always choose this model to fight first in the Fight phase even if it did not charge. If the enemy has units that have charged, or that have a similar ability, alternate choosing units to fight with, starting with the player whose turn is taking place.

profiles.name: 46: Foresight
chars: Once per battle, if this model is on the battlefield, you can re-roll one hit roll, wound roll, damage roll or saving throw.

profiles.name: 51: Inspirational Leader
chars: Friendly <Sub-faction>units can use this model’s Leadership instead of their own while they are within 6" of it.

profiles.name: 52: Rallying Cry
chars: You can re-roll failed Morale tests for friendly <Sub-faction>units while they are within 6" of this model.

profiles.name: 53: Icon of Retribution
chars: Roll a dice each time a friendly <Sub-faction>model within 6" of this model is slain in the Fight phase. On a 6, the unit that made the attack that slew the model suffers 1 mortal wound after it has finished making its attacks.

profiles.name: 54: Impetuous
chars: You can re-roll failed charge rolls for this model.

profiles.name: 55: Terrifying
chars: Subtract 1 from the Leadership characteristic of enemy units while they are within 3" of this model.

profiles.name: 56: Savage Riposte
chars: Each time you roll an unmodified saving throw of 6 for this model in the Fight phase, the enemy unit that made the attack suffers 1 mortal wound after it has resolved all of its attacks.

profiles.name: 61: Air Strike
chars: Once per battle, in your Shooting phase, you can pick an enemy unit, other than a Characterunit, that is visible to this model and roll a D6. On a 1-4 nothing happens. On a 5+ the target unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

profiles.name: 62: Swift Advance
chars: When this model Advances, add 6" to its Move characteristic for that Movement phase instead of rolling a D6

profiles.name: 63: Reactive Tactics
chars: This model, and friendly<Sub-faction>units within 6" of them, can charge even if they Fell Back that turn.

profiles.name: 64: Strike and Fade
chars: After this model has fought in the Fight phase, it can immediately pile in D3+3" in any direction, not just towards the closest enemy model.

profiles.name: 65: Final Strike
chars: If this model is slain, you can select an enemy unit within 3" of it and roll a D6; on a 2+ that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

profiles.name: 66: Direct Fire
chars: Each time you make a wound roll of 6+ in the Shooting phase for a friendly <Sub-faction>unit within 6" of this model, the AP characteristic of that attack is improved by 1 (e.g. AP -1 becomes AP -2).

profiles.name: 02: Auto-loader

chars: Pick one of this model’s ranged weapons. Improve that weapon’s AP characteristic by 1 (e.g. AP -1 becomes AP -2).

profiles.name: 04: High Calibre

profiles.name: 05: Improved Sights

profiles.name: 06: Inferno Round
chars: Pick one of this model’s ranged weapons. Add the following ability to that weapon: ‘Units do not receive the benefit of cover to their saving throws against attacks made with this weapon.’

profiles.name: 07: Artificer Weapon
chars: Pick one of this model’s weapons. Add 1 to that weapon’s Damage characteristic.

profiles.name: 08: Finely Balanced

profiles.name: 09: Shredder
chars: Pick one of this model’s melee weapons. Add the following ability to that weapon: ‘You can re-roll failed wound rolls for attacks made with this weapon.’

profiles.name: 10: Brutal
chars: Pick one of this model’s melee weapons. Improve that weapon’s Strength characteristic by 1 (e.g. User becomes +1, +1 becomes +2).

profiles.name: 11: Razor-edged
chars: Pick one of this model’s melee weapons. Improve that weapon’s AP characteristic by 1 (e.g. AP -1 becomes AP -2).

profiles.name: 2: Adamantium Will

profiles.name: 3: Master of Lore
chars: Add 1 to the number of psychic powers this model knows from one of the psychic disciplines available to them.

profiles.name: 02: Old War Wound
chars: Select a result from this table, or roll 2D6 to randomly select a result (re-roll if you get this result again). Subtract or worsen this model’s characteristic by the amount described in the result you picked instead of adding or improving it (e.g. if the Ferocious Combatant result was selected, an Attacks characteristic of 3 would become 2, while if the Dead-eyed result was selected, a BS of 3+ would become 4+)

profiles.name: 03: Courageous
chars: Add 1 to this model’s Leadership characteristic.

profiles.name: 04: Ferocious Combatant
chars: Add 1 to this model’s Attacks characteristic.

profiles.name: 05: Mighty
chars: Add 1 to this model’s Strength characteristic.

profiles.name: 06: Dead-eyed
chars: Improve this model’s Ballistic Skill characteristic by 1 (e.g. BS 3+ will become BS 2+), to a maximum of 2+.

profiles.name: 07: Fleet
chars: Add 2" to this model’s Move characteristic.

profiles.name: 08: Blademaster
chars: Improve this model’s Weapon Skill characteristic by 1 (e.g. WS 3+ will become WS 2+), to a maximum of 2+.

profiles.name: 09: Enhanced Physiology
chars: Add 1 to this model’s Toughness characteristic.

profiles.name: 10: Toughened Armor
chars: Improve this model’s Save characteristic by 1 (e.g. Sv 5+ will become Sv 4+), to a maximum of 2+.

profiles.name: 11: Divine Protection
chars: Improve this model’s invulnerable save by 1 (e.g. an invulnerable save of 5+ will become an invulnerable save of 4+), to a maximum of 3+. If this model does not have an invulnerable save, it instead gains a 6+ invulnerable save.

profiles.name: 12: Heroic Constitution
chars: Add 1 to this model’s Wounds characteristic.

profiles.name: Spy Mask
chars: Enemy models do not gain the bonus to thier saving throws for being in cover against attacks made with ranged weapons by this model.

profiles.name: Stealth Suit
chars: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made with ranged weapons that target this model. If this model is in or on a terrain feature, subtract 2 instead.

profiles.name: Deadshot
chars: This model can target a CHARACTER even if it is not the closest enemy unit. In addition, each time an unmodified wound roll of 6 is made for an attack with a ranged weapon by this model, the Damage for that attack is D6

profiles.name: Faultless Aim
chars: If this model remained stationary in its previous movement phase, it always hits on a 2+ when firing a ranged weapon, regardless of modifiers. (hit rolls of 6 are still required when firing overwatch)

profiles.name: Head Shot
chars: After this model has made an attack with a ranged weapon, roll one D6 if a model suffered damage from that attack but has not been slain; on a 3+ that model suffers 1 mortal wound and, if that model is not slain, you can roll one more D6. This time, that model suffers 1 mortal wound on a 4+. Keep rolling one D6, increasing the result required, to cause a mortal wound by 1 each time, until the model being rolled for is slain or the roll is failed.

rules.name: Independent Operative
rules.text: This Model can never have a Warlord Trait. During deployment, you can set this model up in concealment instead of placing it on the battlefield. At the end of any of your movement phases, this model can reveal it's position - set it up anywhere on the battlefield that is more then 9" from any enemy model.

rules.name: Lightning Reflexes
rules.text: A model with this special rule has a 4+ invulnerable save.

rules.name: Execution Force
